name: Tomita Nanaka
source:
A well-mannered and reserved girl.
She has been in love with the main character since her first year of college.
Depending on the route, they may even became closer...?

Calm and full-figured woman.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1161863]Getchu[/url]]
